dataList.content: 我看見了一面有著無數釘子的地板。無論是哪一根釘子，它們的尖端都朝向上方。
就這樣繼續墜落的話，毋庸置疑，我的身體就會這樣被釘子所貫穿……
我無助地墜落，但比起正在落下的衝擊，在那下方等待著我的苦痛更讓我感到恐懼。
但就在那個瞬間，
<color=#4457b1>若是……向著海的話……</color>
伴隨著不知道是誰的聲音，那面地板化作了搖蕩著藍波的浩瀚大海。
然後，那遠洋海波迫近的瞬間……
<color=#916e46>今天也向蒞臨薛西弗斯百貨公司的各位顧客致上真摯的歡迎之意。</color>
<color=#916e46>薛西弗斯百貨公司始終竭盡所能，珍惜每位顧客在此所獲得的體驗。</color>
<color=#916e46>為配合潮流，薛西弗斯百貨公司鼓勵各式各樣的專櫃進駐或撤櫃。敬請各位顧客留意，以免迷路。</color>
<color=#916e46>一如往常，百貨公司內所有樓層的廁所正在維修中，敬請見諒。</color>
<color=#916e46>為防止汙染，目前各樓層僅開放符合相應身分等級的顧客進入。若有任何疑問，請至6樓客服中心洽詢。</color>
<color=#916e46>此外，您可以隨意觸摸展出的人台模特兒。如您對人台模特兒所穿的服裝有任何疑問，請諮詢賣場的銷售人員。我們很樂意為您提供協助。</color>
<color=#916e46>那麼，為確保顧客今日也能享有優質的消費體驗，敬請各位竭盡所能。祝您購物愉快。</color>
剛才我們體驗到的，到底是……
真不想再經歷一次啊。雖然我們確實死過很多次，也經歷過各種不同的死法，但這次不是因為戰鬥……而是自己選擇去死的那種感覺……哦嗚。
N公司的人們是花錢來體驗這種東西的啊。就算給我再多錢，我也拒絕再體驗這種東西。
將可能致命的體驗包裝為娛樂進行販售……
雖然知道克服沉悶並非易事……嗯……
那種感覺比我原本想像中的還要真實。
I knew it was all taking place within a machine... Yet in that moment, I truly felt as though... I were witnessing the final moments of my life.
When the noose tightened, I thought my neck was gonna snap...
I'm with Ishy... People actually pay money to put themselves through this?
There are those who, with no real purpose in mind, tie themselves to a cord and leap from great heights, or surrender themselves to violent waves to see whether or not they will be swept under.
It is said that people come to feel the sensation of being alive more keenly via experiences that bring them infinitely close to death.
... So ya sayin' they do it on purpose?
Distasteful.
Silence prevailed as everyone reeled from the aftermath of the experience.
<Where are we anyway...?>
It was an unnecessary question, actually. The view that entered my sight told me in no uncertain terms what exactly this room's purpose was.
... It's a restroom.
Verily, 'tis a privy!
A place where one's innermost troubles may be emptied.
We went through all that shite in that bloody machine... just to get to a toilet?
It's true Nelly's lies have put us in danger before, but it didn't appear to me that she was trying to harm or deceive us this time around...
Fau. The machine we triggered... was it some kind of teleporter?

The verdict would differ depending on our interpretation of the experience, but it is certain that our bodies were not physically sent to this place. That shouldn't be an issue, however, as this is indeed the destination we were bound for, which we have reached successfully.
So... where the heck are we? Where do we go to find Meur?
Rodya asked, completely lost.
As indicated by the announcement, this place is...
The Grand Magasin Sisyphe. We will be able to locate Meursault here.
That's the factory that produces Canned Experiences, right...?
... That woman standing there might have more information about this place.
She looks similar... to Demian...
Identify yourself. What do you know about this place?
……這裡是……
The woman, with a benevolent smile gracing her lips, is watching us serenely.
The sight of her smile alone is enough to set me at ease.
... It is where everything that is washed away comes to rest. The "Fount"...
... That's not what we asked.
Are you affiliated with this establishment? Can't deny there is something familiar about you.
... All things appear... as one believes them to be.
Well, at least she doesn't seem hostile to us...
Do you happen to know what we're... supposed to do here...? Could you tell us if you do?
……德米安、林、參孫……
She gives off much the same impression as the three of them. Especially in how difficult it is to tell whether she is a friend or a foe.
Then again, those three did, in the end, prove helpful to us to some degree, despite their inscrutable intentions. Perhaps this one will be the same.
Perhaps she had said all she meant to say, because she only gave a silent smile in return. The same benevolent smile she had given us earlier.
Would it still be safe if we just... left through that door over there?
... She still said nothing, but I thought I saw her inclining her head in affirmation ever so slightly.
<... Doesn't look like we got any other choice. Let's just head outside and see what's there.>
